# BogiDope

> BogiDope is the leading resource for military pilot recruitment, training preparation, and career guidance across Air Force, Guard, and Reserve positions.

BogiDope provides comprehensive job boards, coaching services, and educational content for aspiring military pilots preparing for AFOQT, UPT, and fighter pilot careers. The platform combines recruitment tools, test preparation courses, and community resources to guide candidates through the entire military aviation career pipeline.

## Key Topics

- Military Pilot Recruitment
- Air Force Officer Qualifying Test (AFOQT)
- Undergraduate Pilot Training (UPT)
- Air National Guard (ANG)
- Guard/Reserve Selection
- Fighter Pilot Training
- Interview Preparation
- MilRecruiter Platform
- Military Aviation Jobs
- Test Preparation Coaching
- F-16 and F-22 Careers
- Air Force Reserve
- Career Progression
- Interview Debrief Archive
- Military Test Prep

## Job Boards & Recruitment

- [Military Jobs](https://bogidope.com/military): Military pilot job board for Guard/Reserve and US military positions
- [Civilian Aviation Jobs](https://bogidope.com/civilian): Civilian aviation job board with Top Aces, Amentum, and Million Air
- [Submit a Job Listing](https://bogidope.com/submit-a-job-listing): Job listing submission for Air Force, Air National Guard, and civilian roles
- [MilRecruiter Platform](https://bogidope.com/milrecruiter): MilRecruiter platform login for military pilot recruitment and career resources

## Training & Test Preparation

- [Career Dashboard](https://bogidope.com/career-dashboard): Career dashboard guiding Air Force pilot path through UPT and AFOQT
- [Bootcamp Program](https://bogidope.com/bootcamp): 8-week BogiDope Bootcamp for Guard & Reserve pilot application coaching
- [Courses Archive](https://bogidope.com/courses): Course archive for MilPilot Academy and AFOQT prep training content
- [Coaching Comparison](https://bogidope.com/compare): Coaching comparison guide for AFOQT, SIFT, ASVAB, and UPT preparation
- [Schedule 1-on-1 Coaching](https://bogidope.com/schedule): 1-on-1 coaching scheduling for military test prep and interview coaching

## Community & Resources

- [Forums Archive](https://bogidope.com/forums): Forums archive covering military pilot training and Air Force recruitment
- [Podcast Archive](https://bogidope.com/podcast): Podcast archive with fighter pilot interviews and military aircraft analysis
- [Community Groups](https://bogidope.com/groups): Community groups for Air Force pilot training and AFOQT test preparation
- [Application Archive](https://bogidope.com/application-archive): Archive of resume examples and cover letters for Air Force UPT applications
- [Interview Debrief Submissions](https://bogidope.com/add-new-log-trip-report): Interview debrief submission tool for pilot interview preparation insights

## Pricing & Membership

- [Pricing Plans](https://bogidope.com/pricing): Pricing for MilPILOT Membership, Afterburner Academy, and MilRecruiter
